shared_elements: low-relief incised surface decoration on stone
justification: Both depict human figures rendered in low relief with schematic headgear and include disc-like round motifs (rosettes in A, concentric circles on the torso in B), but that is about as far as it goes. A shows a horizontal procession of naturalistically proportioned profile figures in ordered registers with an animal and a rosette band, whereas B is a single frontal massive block-like torso and head with isolated symbolic markings and no narrative sequence or register system.
